event_id.description: Stable unique id for this message. Retries must reuse the same id.

event_version.description: Payload schema version for this event_type. Additive fields only within a version.

occurred_at.description: When the fact happened in the domain, UTC.

source.description: Producer identity: apps.api | services.ingestion | services.detection | services.incident | services.ai | services.remediation

correlation_id.description: Workflow id shared from alert through remediation.

causation_id.description: event_id of the message that caused this one. Null for origin events.

idempotency_key.description: Optional command key. Defaults to event_id when omitted.

payload.description: Event-specific body. Defined per event type.
